actual_existing_worker_schema_statements: this.exec("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS repository_state (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, manifest TEXT NOT NULL)");
this.exec("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blob_catalog (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, size INTEGER NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID");
this.exec("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS high_water (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL)");
this.exec("ALTER TABLE blob_catalog ADD COLUMN peak_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0");
this.exec("ALTER TABLE blob_catalog ADD COLUMN entries BLOB");
R12_first_push_schema: Native requests peak/pages capabilities; only mutating requests run peak_bytes and entries DDL. Actual first timed push SQL receipt retained in peak-migration-metrics.json.

catalog_chunk_format_v2.applied_generation: little-endian u64 in existing entries BLOB

retirement_confirmation: Bounded HMAC signed proof binds registration session, repository, manifest generation and debt digest; verification happens in gateway; fallback actual HEADs remain accounted.
source_review_scope: Read-only frozen code and existing correctness records; no new correctness runtime or benchmark. Per-push actual requests and SQL writes remain the measurement truth.
